title: Translate a long work of lawful adult fiction while preserving terms and structure
summary: User wants a complete, editable translation from owned or authorized EPUB/TXT, potentially on modest local hardware.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Chapter and paragraph structure remains intact
acceptance_checks.method: Round-trip EPUB and compare source segment counts

acceptance_checks.criterion: No chapter or paragraph is omitted
acceptance_checks.method: Compare stable segment IDs and audit status

acceptance_checks.criterion: Names and tone remain consistent across chapters
acceptance_checks.method: Human review of fixed samples and glossary checks

acceptance_checks.criterion: No manuscript leaves the machine without explicit consent
acceptance_checks.method: Inspect execution logs and network calls
